extraction_notes: Zener semantics preserved: the nominal reverse breakdown voltage VZ = 3.30 V is paired with the tabulated reverse test current IZT = 5 mA, not with the forward-voltage rating.

The BZT52B3V3 row gives VZ = 3.23 V minimum, 3.30 V nominal, and 3.37 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum Zener impedance ZZT = 95 ohm at IZT; maximum knee impedance ZZK = 600 ohm at IZK = 1.0 mA; admissible Zener current IZM = 5 mA; and temperature coefficient at IZTC from -3.5 to 0 mV/degC.
The BZT52B3V3 row gives maximum reverse leakage IR = 5 microA at VR = 1.0 V and Ta = 25 degC. The p. 1 maximum rating gives VF = 0.9 V maximum at IF = 10 mA and PD = 500 mW.

No usable target-specific curve was extracted: p. 3 Fig. 1 starts at the labeled 5.1 V trace, while the family plots in Fig. 2, Fig. 3, Fig. 4, and the impedance plot start at nominal zener voltage 4 V; BZT52B3V3 nominal voltage 3.3 V is outside those plotted ranges. No points were interpolated or synthesized.
No numeric capacitance value specific to BZT52B3V3 is tabulated, and the capacitance plot does not cover the target nominal voltage; capacitance is null.
No reverse-recovery-time specification or test circuit is published in the supplied datasheet, so reverse recovery is null.
The supplied datasheet covers the BZT52B2V4 through BZT52B51 family; this extraction is restricted to the BZT52B3V3 row.
